=== COLUMN 2 ===
WELCOME
We would like to take this opportunity to welcome you to the 3rd Annual Red Carpet Lanes/S.A.l. "Roofing People of America" Late Model
Challenge Race.
While any form of motor sports is exiciting, dirt track racing has been and continues to be the foundation on which a driver develops his racing
skills. Mario Andrett, A.J. Foyt, Parnelli Jones and yes, Ken Schrader, whom you will be watching compete tonight, have all won national dirt
track championships.
The previous two S.A.l. Challenge races had been successful, entertaining and received fan support. It is always difficult to improve upon
success, but we are confident the 3rd annual Red Carpet Lanes/S.A.l. Late Model Challenge will do just that.
The progressive formal will eliminate time trials. Drivers will draw numbers for starting positions in one of the five qualifying 12-lap heat races.
The top four finishers in each heat race will progress to the starting field for the Red Baron Pizza 5O-lap feature. The winner of the first heat
race will start on the inside of row 1 and the winner of the second heat race will start on the outside of row 1, etc.
The drivers which do not qualify through their respective heat race will be given one last chance to qualify for the Red Baron Pizza 5O-Lap
feature by finishing either first or second in the 20-Lap Milwaukee Insulation semi-feature.
The 22 cars that qualify through the heat races and semi-feature, plus two promoters choices will comprise the 24 car field for the feature
event.
A special treat this yearwill be the Montana Trucking 15-lap Austrialian Pursuit race. This race will feature Rusty Wallace, Ken Schrader, Milke
Melius, Brian Jaeger, Bill Prietzel and Gordie Seegert, Jr. battling to keep from being passed. The cars will start single file based on the
number drawn prior to the event. Once a driver is passed he is out of the race. The last car running, or leader after 15-laps, is the winner.
It is every racing promoters goal to please and thrill his audience. We are confident the 3rd Annual Red Carpet Lanes/S.A.l. Challenge will do
just that.
Your comments both positive and negative are always welcome and we would encourage any fan with a compliment or complaint to contact
Promotion Associates Group in writing.
We would like to thank our many sponsors for their support for without their cooperation this event would not have been possible. Special
thanks to Midwest Speedways Inc. and its staff for the assistance and guidance they have provided.
Now, let's all sit back and enjoy the Red Carpet Lanes/S.A.l. Challenge!
Ron Werwoinski/Dennis Czarnyszka

West Allis, WI 53227
